verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Runpod serves an llms.txt at docs.runpod.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing its developer documentation. Its docs pages are also published as raw .md URLs, and dedicated agent-skills guidance tells users to have a coding agent act on Runpod in natural language. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explaining how to point agents at llms.txt, and evidence of an expanded full-content variant (e.g., llms-full.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.runpod.io/llms.txt # Runpod Documentation
Developer documentation for building, deploying, and scaling AI applications on Runpod.
Once installed, you can ask your agent to create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, or deploy your own code with Flash, all in natural language.
